Zoho People pricing in 2026

Zoho People is still the cheapest published per-user rate in the category, but the US buyer and the rest of the world are shown different plans off the same URL. In the US the ladder is Essential HR $3, Workforce $5, Talent $5 and Enterprise $8 per user/month billed annually, or $4 / $6 / $6 / $10 month-to-month, with a free plan for up to 3 users.

US visitors get Free / Essential HR / Workforce / Talent / Enterprise at $3 / $5 / $5 / $8 per user/month billed annually. What the buying committee actually pays

Still the cheapest published per-user rate in the category. The figures here are the US line-up, because that is what a US buyer following the link will see; a reader outside the US sees Essential HR at $1.25 per user/month billed annually instead. The ledger applies a default 12% annual renewal uplift unless the buyer caps it in the MSA - our own central modelling assumption, adjustable on the renewal-uplift page, not a vendor-published rate.

What do the US tiers cost per user per month?

Billed annually: Essential HR $3, Workforce $5, Talent $5, Enterprise $8. Month-to-month: $4, $6, $6, $10. The page opens on the annual toggle, so the annual figure is the one most buyers see first. Above 500 users Zoho routes you to a price quote.

Why do other sites quote Zoho People at $1.25 or $1.50?

Because Zoho serves two plan line-ups from the same pricing URL and picks by visitor IP. Outside the US the tiers are Essential HR, Professional, Premium and Enterprise at $1.25, $2, $3 and $4.50 per user/month billed annually. A US visitor never sees those tiers, and a non-US visitor never sees Workforce or Talent. Both sets of figures are genuine; they just are not offered to the same buyer.

Is the free plan really usable?

The free edition is capped at 3 users for a US account and 5 users outside the US, which makes it a trial footprint rather than a plan a small business can sit on. It covers employee database management, time off and vacation planning, and document management.

How does Zoho People bundle with Zoho Payroll and Zoho One?

Zoho Payroll is sold separately. The US Standard plan is $29 per org/month billed annually plus $5 per employee/month, or $39 plus $6 month-to-month; Professional is $49 plus $7 billed annually. Zoho One is a separate bundle: All Employee Pricing is $37 per employee/month billed annually, $45 month-to-month. Zoho's own payroll FAQ states that Zoho Payroll on the Standard plan is included in Zoho One.

What modules sit at each US tier?

Essential HR carries the AI agent, benefits and compensation planning, onboarding and offboarding, document management, engagement surveys, HR helpdesk and reporting. Workforce adds time off and vacation planning, timesheets with OT compliance, and attendance. Talent adds OKR and performance evaluation plus LMS. Enterprise bundles Essential HR, Workforce and Talent together and adds Sandbox and premium support.

When does Zoho People beat BambooHR or Gusto on cost?

Always on raw subscription cost. The question is whether the customer values Zoho's broader app ecosystem (CRM, Books, Mail) more than BambooHR's polished employee experience or Gusto's native US payroll.
